'''Phraken-Nal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3640 BBY]], Phraken-Nal assisted the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Tala-Reh]] in search to rescue [[Valen-Da]] and stop [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] from spreading chaos on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].
